Brief 12's (c) and its results kept word for word beside it; H4-R's tenth and 1/12 decide nothing.
rows.exercised: Every piece a player can play restrained (784: 97 class scenes and plays, 30 nights, 657 brief readings), judged through the context the judge reads (`R2Case.context`, checked to give brief 12's measure byte for byte), for brief 12's five actors and the nine fresh comparison actors (the measurement) and the five (the gate); a share of difficulty set directly for the boundary tests (TEST SETUP); and played through the brief commands on Rockumentary's readings at +0.01 and −0.02, taped, saved and opened again.

trace.ten: The ten brief readings at ±0.01 (brief-grindhouse/terror, brief-isekai/nobody, brief-rockumentary/relief, brief-science_fantasy/wonder, brief-dance-2/two, brief-melodrama-2/pride, brief-musical-2/love, brief-mystery-2/cornered, brief-psychological_horror-2/together, brief-psychological_horror-2/loop): one common cause, grainOf's internal quantization. suitabilityOf keeps each signal and s to a hundredth; grainOf works the share of difficulty as GRAIN.strength × s × stakesScale × (lean − 1)/most, 0.0026 to 0.0039 on believability and 0.0005 to 0.0008 on consistency at stakes 0 to 3, and keeps it to a hundredth: nothing; the mark stays 0.9. The judge gets the same inputs read or not, so the exact takes are equal (50 of 50), which is not display rounding (the result's tenth) and no gameplay limit (no floor, hold or cap reached). Carried at full precision each moves the right way, by 0.0629 at most for brief 12's actors (0.0777 for the fresh ones), 47 of 140 actor-cases a shown tenth. From ±0.02 every take moves the right way (least 0.0061); none of 784 moves the wrong way. The hundredth was undocumented; it is now, in grainOf's comment.
trace.sixtyFive: The 65 of 6,344 pairs: one common cause in three parts. Each ability has a path into the take (61 direct, 16 of them restraint's own draws, focus 9 and composure 7; 1 a supporting read, listening in Major Barbara's scene; 3 stamina through the drain; none unrelated). Each lead (0.0509 to 0.5527) is the equal budget's arithmetic: the strength's own gain alone (2.3656 to 3.2484) plus the eleven's own cost alone (−2.2772 to −2.6816) plus an interaction of −0.1654 to +0.0165; every share over 1/12 (0.0876 at least). All 65 are against the grain, and under a tenth, because only there is believability alone at the bottom of every segment of the even actor's take (65 of 65; 171 of the 514 others in the window; 0 of 664 with the grain or level): there a +10 and the specialist's −3.18 move the whole's weakest term alike and the +10 shares are linear (the eleven's cost over what the shares predict, median 1.028), while elsewhere connection, consistency and responsiveness, which read no technique, tie at the bottom and the shares understate the cost by about a third (median 1.344 to 1.379), so the break-even rises to about a tenth: with the grain or level no specialist under a tenth is ahead. 38 are ahead with no way chosen too, 30 played expansive, 33 with the grain at nothing: the work's arithmetic, not restraint's. Under 1/12, 0 of 5,101 above the even actor at all. Each pair is listed with its decomposition and path in acting/trace.json (sixtyFive).

rows.dependencyMap: From the context the judge reads: direct where restraint draws on it or a dimension reads it at least as much as the work's own profile reads that dimension's leading ability; small but legitimate where only under that (a supporting read); indirect where only the drain reads it (stamina, on every piece); none where nothing in the take does. On the 784: emotional depth, composure, focus (restraint's draws), presence, imagination, memory, adaptability and discipline direct everywhere; listening direct on 73 scenes, 18 nights and every brief reading, small on 24 and 12; vocal direct 70/15/444, small 27/15/12, none on 201 brief readings; physical direct 62/14/516, small 35/16, none on 141 brief readings; stamina indirect everywhere. Outside the take, held fixed by a controlled take: preparation (focus, memory, imagination, adaptability, listening speed a class scene's steps; imagination, memory and listening a brief's; memory and adaptability a night's; the choice's own rehearsal reads no ability), condition (composure and adaptability recover a slip; composure lessens nerves; stamina sets a night's energy), progression (discipline lifts all growth). Unrelated means none: vocal and physical on the 342 brief readings that stage neither. Checked one input at a time: 9,408 of 9,408 on the even actor in the trace, 131,712 of 131,712 for fourteen actors in the measurement.

results.cause: The margin parts fail by one demonstrated cause: the scene's grain is a share of difficulty, read as capacity^(1 + difficulty), whose points depend on the capacity they meet (more for a weaker dimension, up to 1/e, and the weakest dimension counts in the whole twice). Where the grain carries much of a side's benefit, the comparison actor, weaker where that side leans, gains more from it than the counterpart. On brief-romantic_drama-2/plan the even actor's restrained take gains 2.406 from the grain and the restrained specialist's 1.724, so their restraint margins are 3.740 and 3.529; with the grain at nothing, −0.013 and 1.315. On a scene suited to size, an actor weak in presence has its weak connection lifted most. With the grain at nothing for both takes, every margin part holds on every piece for all fourteen comparison actors: the extra margin 0.4668 at least for restraint and 0.5454 for size, the other side's margin behind by 0.4978 and 0.6559 at least. The stage gains for size are few because actors leaning toward restraint by 10 to 20 already have 47 to 56 of the 57 stage pieces size suits.

decision.question: Should (e2.3), (e3.3) and (e4)'s margins be read on the abilities' part alone, both takes judged with the scene's grain at nothing, with the margins as played kept as the record; and should (e3.5) on stage be read on the size counterparts' own opportunities (varied on every actor) with their 10 gains reported, rather than the gains alone?
decision.evidence: As in results; acting/st6r2-13-e.json (verdict.e2, verdict.e3, atNoGrain, and per actor extraNotOver005 and otherSideNotBehind), and the trace of romantic_drama-2/plan above.
decision.recommendation: Accept both and close ST6-R2.e. The specialist advantage the owner asked for is what the specialist's abilities do, and the grain at nothing isolates exactly that, one input held for both actors; it held on every piece for every one of the fourteen comparison actors. It was added to the measure beside the verdict after the informing actors were checked and before the fresh ones ran (0ddfaed1), and the fresh run met it with no exception; it was seen after the informing check, so it's proposed, not adopted. On stage, size's room for actors leaning toward restraint is 1 to 10 pieces each, so a quarter of 10 gained pieces is 2 from one play; the counterparts' own opportunities there meet the floors. Keeping the clause as written leaves ST6-R2.e not met.
